title: Can You Spot the Real Order Block? 90% Get This Wrong
description: Think you know order blocks? Most traders — even funded ones — fail this. Test yourself with this quick quiz and see where you actually stand. R2F Trading breaks it down in 30 seconds. Follow for daily ICT concepts that actually make sense. r2ftrading.com
script: Stop. Before your next trade — can you actually identify a real order block? 90% of traders get this wrong. Let's find out which side you're on. Here's the setup. Price sweeps a high, drops hard, then rallies back. Which candle is the order block? The last bearish candle before the drop — OR the first bullish candle after? Most beginners pick the bullish candle. Feels logical, right? Price went up from there. But that's the mistake costing traders funded accounts every single week. The REAL order block? The last bearish candle before the explosive move down. That's where smart money placed their orders. That's the origin of the move. Why? Because institutions sold there first. Price comes back to that zone to fill remaining orders — then continues the original direction. That's the R2F Trading system in action.
